resources.string: Settings specific to this Camry and its Pioneer head unit
Project CarPlay navigation to the HUD and instrument cluster. Turning off takes effect immediately.
Start guidance within the selected distance. Keep the current instruction until it changes.
Choose distances for turns, complex maneuvers and straight guidance. Road class is not inferred.
Estimate time to the maneuver from distance changes. Fall back to distance when stopped or when data is unreliable.
Fork, ramp, roundabout and U-turn distance
Strategy and parameter changes apply at the next instruction. Current guidance stays stable. No reconnection needed.
CarPlay does not expose road class or traffic-signal data, so projection timing is estimated from guidance distance only. The HUD experience cannot fully match the factory navigation.
